title: Compare credit cards
dek: Original aFinanceCalculator desk notes — not issuer offers and not NerdWallet reviews. Confirm terms on the issuer site before you apply.

cards.name: Flat Cash Everyday
cards.highlight: Simple flat earn — no rotating categories.

cards.name: Grocery & Gas Boost
cards.highlight: Category earners who hit the cap still get a solid flat fallback.

cards.name: Travel Miles Select
cards.rewards: 3x travel & dining, 2x transit, 1x else + lounge credit variants
cards.highlight: Worth it when annual travel credits clear the fee.

cards.name: 0% Purchase Starter
cards.rewards: 1% cash back after intro, or none during 0%
cards.highlight: Best for a planned big purchase you can clear before go-to APR.

cards.name: Balance Transfer Relief
cards.introApr: 0% on transfers for 18 months (3% fee typical)
cards.highlight: Run the fee vs interest-saved math before you move a balance.

cards.name: Premium Travel Bundle
cards.rewards: High earn on travel portals + credits that must be used
cards.highlight: Only pencil this if you will use the credits every year.
